from pathlib import Path

code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    n = len(g)
    sep = next(v for v in range(1, 10) if all(all(x == v for x in row) for row in g) and sum(all(x == v for x in row) for row in g) >= 1)
    row_bands = [i for i, row in enumerate(g) if all(x == sep for x in row)]
    col_bands = [j for j in range(len(g[0])) if all(g[i][j] == sep for i in range(n))]
    rstarts = [0] + [i + 1 for i in row_bands]
    rends = row_bands + [n]
    cstarts = [0] + [j + 1 for j in col_bands]
    cends = col_bands + [len(g[0])]
    # Find the non-label, nonempty panel; its occupied shape is the template.
    template = None
    for ri, (rs, re) in enumerate(zip(rstarts, rends)):
        for ci, (cs, ce) in enumerate(zip(cstarts, cends)):
            if ci == 0:
                continue
            pts = [(r-rs, c-cs, g[r][c]) for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cs, ce) if g[r][c] != 0]
            if pts:
                template = (re-rs, ce-cs, [(a,b) for a,b,_ in pts])
                break
        if template:
            break
    if template is None:
        return g
    h, w, mask = template
    for ri, (rs, re) in enumerate(zip(rstarts, rends)):
        # The first panel in each band carries the row's color.
        colors = [g[r][c] for r in range(rs, re) for c in range(cstarts[0], cends[0]) if g[r][c] not in (0, sep)]
        if not colors:
            continue
        color = colors[0]
        for ci, (cs, ce) in enumerate(zip(cstarts, cends)):
            for r in range(rs, re):
                for c in range(cs, ce):
                    g[r][c] = 0
            for a, b in mask:
                g[rs+a][cs+b] = color
    return g
'''
